item.title: KBR expert identifies five trends reshaping oil and gas in 2026
item.description: Paul Bansil, Director of KBR’s international consulting business, has outlined five major trends that will shape how oil and gas operators navigate the year ahead as project developers allocate capital more selectively, face growing regulatory scrutiny, and tackle the challenges of decarbonising existing assets.

item.title: RWE and Glenfarne sign 20-year supply agreement
item.description: RWE Supply & Trading and Texas LNG Brownsville LLC, part of Glenfarne Group, LLC, have signed a 20-year sales and purchase agreement for 1 million tpy of LNG.

item.title: Eni announces hull launch of Coral North FLNG
item.description: China National Petroleum Corp., ENH, KOGAS, and XRG has announced the hull launch of the Coral North FLNG, fully in line with the project schedule.

item.title: IEEFA: EU risks new energy dependence as US could supply 80% of its LNG imports by 2030
item.description: Research by the IEEFA shows the EU’s rising reliance on US LNG has created a potentially high-risk geopolitical dependency and could cause it to miss its gas demand reduction commitments.

item.title: Wärtsilä signs lifecycle agreement for 12 new LNG carriers
item.description: Wärtsilä has signed a 10-year lifecycle agreement with MOL Global Ship Management for 12 LNG carriers.

item.title: Mitsubishi Corp. acquires Haynesville shale gas business in Louisiana and Texas
item.description: Mitsubishi Corp. has agreed to acquire all equity interests in Aethon III LLC, Aethon United LP, and related entities and interests.

item.title: Klaipeda LNG reloading station closes 2025 with record results
item.description: In 2025, the Klaipeda LNG reloading station, operated by KN Energies, loaded the highest number of LNG trucks since the start of the station’s operations and handled a record number of small scale LNG carriers.

item.title: ADNOC Gas signs LNG deal with HPCL
item.description: ADNOC Gas plc and its subsidiaries has announced the signing of a sales and purchase agreement valued at between US$2.5 – US$3 billion for a period of 10 years with Hindustan Petroleum Corp. Ltd.

item.title: Woodfibre LNG moves another step closer to completion
item.description: Woodfibre LNG has welcomed the arrival of two major modules for the Woodfibre LNG facility, reaching another important construction milestone in making the world’s first net-zero LNG facility a reality.

item.title: Future-ready safety: Powering nearshore FLNG installations – Part one
item.description: A safety report by ABS explores design considerations for innovative floating LNG power solutions to support the energy transition industry.
